description: Sets up the organization's eth key pair, used for TEE session binding (`sessions.create({ orgEthPrivateKey })`) and, with `encryptResults`, encrypted result delivery (`results.receive(body, { orgEthPrivateKey })`). Writes the private key to a server env file in the project (reusing a key already there) and registers only the public key. Returns the address, file, and variable; never the key. Returns 409 when the org already has a different key. Set `replace: true` only when the developer asked to rotate or replace the key: it generates a new key and swaps it in one step, and apps holding the old key can no longer decrypt new results. The old key is first appended to `<envFile>.backup` (gitignored); tell the developer its path.

encryptResults.description: Encrypt delivered results to this key. Default false, or the org's current setting with `replace`.

envFile.description: Env file to write, relative to `projectDir`. Default `.env`.

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the app's project directory.

replace.description: Rotate: generate a new key and replace the org's current one. Default false.

name: issue_org_keypair
